revenue.source: MCD 10-K FY2024 (acc. 0000063908-25-000012) and FY2025 (acc. 0000063908-26-000035); FY2025 from stock-analysis-on.net income statement

d_and_a.source: MCD cash flow statement via edgar.tools/companies/MCD, consistent with 10-K

capex.source: MCD cash flow statement via edgar.tools/companies/MCD, consistent with 10-K

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 3.7%; comps +3.1%, unit growth of ~2,100 net openings/yr supports mid-single-digit growth fading toward 3.5%

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 operating margin 46.1% per 10-K, held flat (FY2024 45.2%)

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. US statutory 21% plus state/foreign, near MCD's recent effective rate; rationale only, not filing-verified

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 12.5% (3,365/26,885) elevated by opening push; FY2024 10.7%; blended 11.5% as openings plan moderates

wacc.source: Assumption: beta ~0.6-0.7, rf ~4.3%, ERP ~5% gives cost of equity ~7.5-8%; after-tax cost of debt ~4%, ~10% debt weight; rounded 7.5%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal growth below rf/GDP; 2.5%

net_debt.source: FY2025 10-K: debt obligations $39,973m (balance sheet) less cash and equivalents $774m; no short-term investments found

diluted_shares.source: FY2025 10-K / Q4-25 press release: weighted-average diluted shares 716.4m
